In Magic: The Gathering, if an opponent gains control of a creature that you have equipped with an item, the creature will move under the opponent's control, but the equipment will remain under your control. This is because the control of the equipment and the creature are separate (RAG Database Response). 

The equipment will stay attached to the creature, but you retain the ability to move it to another creature you control, if applicable (Google Search Summary). If the creature dies, the equipment becomes unattached but still remains under your control. 

The opponent cannot use the equipment's abilities, only you can, as you are the controller of the equipment. However, the creature is now under the opponent's control and they can use the creature's abilities (RAG Database Response). 

This means you can still control the equipment and can move it to another creature you control during your turn (Reddit Summary).
